name: ovos-spec-tools
description: Reference implementation of the OVOS formal specifications — sentence template expander, locale resource loader, dialog renderer, language matching, and a locale linter
author: OpenVoiceOS

setup_notes.heading: Install
setup_notes.content:
pip install ovos-spec-tools            # core — no dependencies
pip install ovos-spec-tools[langcodes] # adds the smart language fallback

Requires Python 3.10+.
